name: How does Colorado's expansive soil affect ceramic tile installation?

mainEntity.name: How does Colorado's expansive soil affect ceramic tile installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Denver metro area, soil movement caused by expansive bentonite clay can cause home foundations and concrete slabs to shift, increasing the risk of cracked tile floors. When installing ceramic tile over concrete slabs in Denver, Centennial, and Parker homes, installers often use uncoupling crack-isolation membranes beneath the thin-set. This membrane separates the ceramic tile from the underlying slab, absorbing minor structural shifting and preventing slab hairline cracks from transferring directly up through your finished tile and grout.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expansive soils cause foundation movement, which requires using crack-isolation membranes beneath ceramic tiles to prevent foundation shifts from cracking the floor.
